specTitle: Test Case 1: Navigate to All Phones listing via Mobile dropdown
title: AC1: Navigate to Mobile Devices Listing via Mobile dropdown
preconditions:
User has launched https://www.starhub.com/personal.html in a browser.
No prior session / not logged in.
steps:
1. Click the "Mobile" navigation tab to open the dropdown megamenu.
2. In the "Mobile Phones" column click "All Phones".
expected:
Browser navigates to consumer.starhub.com/personal/store/mobile/devices.
"Mobile Devices" heading is visible.
Device listing shows at least one item (count text matches /\d+ items/).

specTitle: Test Case 2: Select Samsung Galaxy A57 5G from the device listing
title: AC2: Select Samsung Galaxy A57 5G device from All Phones listing
preconditions: User is on the All Phones listing page: consumer.starhub.com/personal/store/mobile/devices.
steps:
1. Locate the "Galaxy A57 5G" device card.
2. Click the card.
expected:
Browser navigates to a URL containing "galaxy-a57-5g".
"Samsung Galaxy A57 5G" breadcrumb title is visible on the product detail page.

specTitle: Test Case 3: Verify Samsung Galaxy A57 5G default configuration
title: AC3: Verify default colour, storage, and payment options on Galaxy A57 5G PDP
preconditions:
User is on the Galaxy A57 5G product detail page.
No prior selection has been made.
steps:
1. Observe the Colour label above the colour swatches.
2. Observe the Storage label and storage option chips.
3. Observe the Payment option selector.
expected:
Colour label reads "Colour: Awesome Navy" (live default as of April 2026).
Storage label reads "Storage: 256GB" and the 256GB chip is visible.
The "24-month" payment option chip is marked active.

specTitle: Test Case 4: Click Next to initiate the purchase journey next step
title: AC4: Clicking Next on the PDP initiates the next purchase step
preconditions:
User is on the Galaxy A57 5G PDP.
Default configuration is applied (colour, storage, 24-month payment).
User is NOT logged in.
steps: 1. Click the "Next" button in the purchase summary section.
expected:
System initiates the next step — confirmed by the auth gate popup becoming visible.
User remains on the same URL (no full-page redirect).

specTitle: Test Case 5: Verify login and sign-up popup after clicking Next
title: AC5: Login/Sign-up popup is displayed for unauthenticated users clicking Next
preconditions: User is on the Galaxy A57 5G PDP and is NOT logged in.
steps:
1. Click the "Next" button.
2. Observe the popup that appears.
expected:
An overlay modal becomes visible.
Modal message reads: "Please log in or create an account to continue with your purchase".
"Log in with Hub ID" button is visible.
"Don't have an account? Sign up here" button is visible.
